<!--
================================================================================
  Figure Panel  : 3D
  Description   : Scatter/heatmap visualisation of the 13 CpG probes most
                  highly correlated with PTK2 (FAK) gene expression in TCGA
                  COAD RAS-mutant tumours. Methylation beta-values vs RNA-seq
                  expression are plotted per probe with Pearson r annotation.
  Input data    : TCGA methylation beta-values (selected probes)
                  TCGA PTK2 RNA-seq expression
                  tcga_coadread_pancanatlas_RAS_mutant_MSS_TCGA_barcodes.txt
  Output        : 3D_..._PTK2_methylation_correlated_probes.pdf
  R packages    : ggplot2, ggpubr, dplyr, reshape2
  Authors       : Sadanandam Lab, Institute of Cancer Research, London
  Contact       : anguraj.sadanandam@icr.ac.uk
  Note          : Update file paths in Chunk 1 before running.
================================================================================
-->

This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
# read PTK2 methylation data
data <- read.table("20251106_TCGA_PTK2_methylation_13_highly_correlated.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dim(data)

# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
#  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue", midpoint = mean(data$Corr)) +

# Plot with color gradient based on correlation
#pdf("20251106_TCGA_PTK2_methylation_13_highly_correlated_plot.pdf")
ggplot(data, aes(x = Distance, y = Correlation, label = Probe, color = "blue")) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_segment(data = data,
                 aes(x = Distance, xend = Distance, y = 0, yend = Correlation),
                 color = "gray30")+
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation vs Distance Colored by Corr Value",
    x = "Distance",
    y = "Correlation",
    color = "Corr"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
#dev.off()
```
